entities.description: table 2 presents the main experimental results of the paper
trig c refers to the task of trigger word identification and classification in event extraction
arg c refers to the task of argument identification and classification in event extraction
text2event is an event extraction model used as a baseline in the experiments
hdgse is an event extraction model used as a baseline in the experiments
ace05 e  is a dataset used for testing event extraction models
ere en is a dataset used for testing event extraction models  noted for having more events and roles than ace05 e
f1 is an evaluation metric used to measure the performance of the models on trig c and arg c tasks
